$description: Component conventions for brand v2: only what the posts draw so far, a select field with a multi-select list. Values are web px at 1×. A 1080 px post draws a component at 2× (post-scale), so a 10px radius becomes 20px there. Shape rules follow tokens/shape.json; colours come from brand/palette.json; sizes from brand/typography.json. Hand-authored.

post-scale.$description: Multiplier from web px to post px. At 2× a 16px text reads about 12px on a phone, the post floor.

icon-stroke.$description: One stroke for every icon inside a component: the chevron, the checkbox tick, the error icon. Round caps and joins.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus and an open field. Same shape as tokens/shape.json focus-ring; colour moves to magenta-mid, the v2 step that clears 3:1 on both grounds.

offset.$description: The gap shows the ground (mist on a UI post), so the ring reads as separate from the border.

field.$description: The closed control: a button that opens a list. One border, one radius, the value on the left and a chevron on the right.

padding-inline.$description: Start, end. The end is tighter because the chevron carries its own space.

rest.$description: 4.1:1 on white, above the 3:1 a control boundary needs.

error.$description: Same width as rest. The error is carried by colour, icon and message, never by a heavier border.

placeholder.$description: 6.4:1 on white, so placeholder text still passes AA.

chevron.$description: Outline icon at icon-stroke, navy. Points down closed, up open.

listbox.$description: The open list under a field.

offset.$description: Field to list. Clears the focus ring (2 + 2px) with room to spare.

shadow.$description: Navy at 12 %. The only shadow in the brand: an open list has to sit above the page. Every other surface stays flat.

option.$description: One row in the list. Rows are inset from the list edge so a hovered row reads as a shape, not a stripe.

height.$description: Squeeze to 28px before shrinking any text when a list must fit a square post.

hover.$description: Only the row under the pointer.

checked.$description: Navy fill, paper tick at icon-stroke. Checked stays neutral: selection is not an accent.

helper.$description: Text under a field. Error text uses magenta-deep with a 16px outline icon: calm, polite, 6.2:1 on paper.

gap.$description: From the field, or from the open list when the list is shown.

icon.$description: Error uses the circled exclamation, outline, at icon-stroke. Not an i, which reads as a tip, and not a triangle or a circled X, which read as a warning or a blocking failure and are louder than an error should be here. Slightly taller than the cap height, which balances a round icon against text.
